title: Episode 1
overview: At a festival with her housemates, Botan runs off to find Ibuki, who is enjoying a highball on a bench alone.

title: Episode 2
overview: Botan tries shochu for the first time with Kanade. Ibuki takes Botan to a boutique that serves alcohol.

title: Episode 3
overview: Botan invites Ibuki on a trip to a private hot spring bath, where she musters liquid courage to ask a favor.

title: Episode 4
overview: Botan and Ibuki sneak away at a shrine to shop for liquor, while the other dorm residents do some sightseeing.

title: Episode 5
overview: Botan visits a bar for the first time. Kanade makes strawberry-infused whisky to give as a gift to Ibuki.

title: Episode 6
overview: Botan and Ibuki visit a limestone cavern with Chin-Lan, the new dorm resident, and go drinking afterwards.

title: Episode 7
overview: Ibuki, Kanade, and Chin-Lan climb Mt. Buko. Botan and Ibuki take a trip to Tokyo to watch a planetarium show.

title: Episode 8
overview: Yaeka invites Akane, Botan, and Chin-Lan to a bathhouse. Botan and Ibuki go drinking by the riverside.

title: Episode 9
overview: Ibuki, Kanade, and Chin-Lan hold a drinking session in the dorm. Botan and Ibuki go on a glamping trip.

title: Episode 10
overview: Kanade and the others take a trip to the museum. Akane and Yaeka reminisce over a shared song from their past.

title: Episode 11
overview: Kanade and Chin-Lan discuss movies over drinks at an izakaya. Botan visits her first hookah lounge with Akane.

title: Episode 12
overview: Kanade and Chin-Lan exchange Christmas gifts. Botan and Ibuki take a hot spring trip to Echigo-Yuzawa.
